data.gender_notes: Dorene is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Dorene means 'Gift of God'. This name is rooted in the Judeo-Christian tradition and is often given to girls born into a religious family or community. Dorene is a name that signifies a deep connection to the divine and a strong spiritual foundation. The name Dorene carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dorene usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine grace and blessings.
data.etymology: Dorene belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dorene total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: דורין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם דורין הוא נגזרת מהמילה היוונית 'דורוס', שפירושה מתנה. הוא קשור למילה העברית 'דור', שפירושה דור או תקופה. השם דורין משמש כמחווה לאלוהים ולדורות הבאים.

in_greek.name: Δορενη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Δορενη προέρχεται από το ελληνικό 'δωρός', που σημαίνει δώρα. Είναι ένα όνομα που συνδέεται με την έννοια της δωρεάς και της χαράς. Στην παράδοση των πρώτων Χριστιανών, το όνομα αυτό συμβόλιζε την πνευματική δωρεά και την αγάπη του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Dorene
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Dorene derivatur ex verbo Graeco 'doros', quod donum significat. In traditione christiana, nomen hoc donum Dei et charitatem spiritualem repraesentat. Olim, hoc nomen mulieribus christianis datum est, quae dono Dei et virtutibus suis insignes erant.

in_english.name: Dorene
in_english.meaning: Gift of God, woman from Doros
in_english.long_meaning: The name Dorene originates from the Greek word 'doros', meaning gift. It is associated with the Hebrew word 'dor', meaning generation or era. In Christian tradition, Dorene symbolizes a gift from God, representing spiritual generosity and divine love. Historically, the name has been used across various Christian cultures, signifying a connection to faith and heritage.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Doreen: Derived from the Hebrew Dor meaning "fish," symbolizing Christ's call to become fishers of men. Spiritually, it signifies a soul devoted to catching and nurturing others into the Christian faith.
